origins.neoorigins.wraith.name: Ko te Wraith
origins.neoorigins.wraith.description: He wairua e whakamamaetia ana e rere ana i roto i te matū mārō. E haere ana i roto i te nuinga o ngā kōpaki engari kāore e taea te haere i roto i te obsidian tae noa ki tōna āhua teitei.
power.neoorigins.wraith_phase.name: Te ahua o te whakaata
power.neoorigins.wraith_phase.descriptio: Toga: haere i roto i ngā kōpae mārō. I roto i tētahi kōpae, rere noa (hopu = ki runga, huri = ki raro). Ko te obsidian, ko te crying obsidian, me te toka taketake e aukati ana i tō haere. Ko te taahiraa e whakakore ana i te hiakai.
Kāore e hiahia ana ki te manawa, ka ora tonu i raro i te wai.
Ka tahuna koe i te marama o te ra.
